tasks.name: D3 Layer 1 — Symptom-first + line-level forcing + evaluator loop
tasks.cost: ~$0.04 (hard panel n=18, zero extra LLM calls)
tasks.scope: H1 (symptom-first prompt) + H4 (require +/- changed line in evidence_quote) + T3 (MechanismEvaluator loop, max 2 rounds, deterministic criterion). Hard panel n=18. Zero topology change — single agent path. Measures: D3 improvement on hard panel vs baseline.

tasks.name: D3 Layer 2a — JIT-SDP defect signature prior (H8a)
tasks.scope: Fine-tune CodeT5+ or UniXCoder on ApacheJIT 28K pairs (temporal cutoff = earliest commit in hard panel). Produce defect_category distribution. Inject as soft prior into HypothesisEngine prompt (H8a variant). Hard panel n=18.
tasks.prerequisites: Defect category taxonomy definition (≤10 categories) before fine-tuning
tasks.success_threshold: D3 ≥ 0.35 on hard panel, OR incremental improvement ≥0.05 over v2-d3-h1h4-t3

tasks.name: D3 Layer 2b — Historical bug RAG (H3a, closed pairs only)
tasks.activation_criterion: v2-d3-h8a: D3 < 0.35 on hard panel, OR H8 fine-tune not yet available
tasks.scope: Embed 28K ApacheJIT buggy commits (closed pairs only, fix_commit.date < earliest hard-panel commit). Query by diff similarity. Inject top-3 defect_category labels (derived from buggy diff heuristic only — no fix info). Hard panel n=18. TEMPORAL GUARD: verify no fix commit content in injected context.

tasks.name: D3 Layer 3 — Debate topology with code-model Agent B (T1 + H2b)
tasks.activation_criterion: Layers 1+2 combined: D3 < 0.35 on hard panel
tasks.cost: ~$0.12 (hard panel n=18, 3 LLM calls/commit: Sonnet + code-model + judge)
tasks.scope: T1 Debate: Agent A (Sonnet, symptom-first H1) vs Agent B (DeepSeek-Coder or Qwen2.5-Coder, code-first). H4 as judge scoring criterion (+/- line evidence quality). Judge is Sonnet. Hard panel n=18.

tasks.name: D3 Layer 4a — Map-Reduce with H8 specialist routing (T2 + H8b)
tasks.activation_criterion: Layer 3: D3 < 0.35 on hard panel tier-1 only (n=11)
tasks.scope: T2 Map-Reduce: H8 defect_signature selects top-2 specialist lanes (from null-reference, lifecycle-ordering, type-narrowing, concurrency). Specialists: Qwen2.5-Coder-7B with narrow focused prompt. Reducer: deterministic script — highest SUPPORTED evidence with +/- line wins. Tier-1 hard panel only (n=11).

tasks.name: D3 Layer 4b — Reasoning model escalation on irreducibles (H5a)

tasks.scope: H5a: escalate truly irreducible tier-1 commits to reasoning model. Mechanism must still pass H4 (cite +/- line). Record: does extended thinking produce a different mechanism, or the same wrong one more verbosely? This result informs whether FPA persists through thinking chains.
